checklist.what: a body part pulls away from its pivot (for example a head sliding off the neck)
a part slides instead of turning about its pivot (only hips and torso may shift, and only a few px)
a moving object has no declared pivot (flag pole, hinge, chain point, axle, holding hand)
a straight scenery line (pole, rail, pillar edge) belongs to a moving character's cut-out
while moving, a gap or crack opens inside a character's silhouette
a character's cut-out contains pixels of another object (that object would move with the character)
one continuous drawn surface is split between two moving characters
before anything moves, the frame does not reproduce the original drawing
a chalk line crosses from a moving piece into a still one (object cut in two)
a small piece of a moving object stays behind
the mesh folds over or is crushed / stretched beyond what cloth and skin allow
a filled background patch becomes visible
a joint turns further than a body can
a resting hand, planted foot or seated body slides
one drawn pixel belongs to two moving objects
a moving object loses part of its drawing while it moves (shredded or hollowed)
an uncovered area does not continue the drawing around it (wrong or mismatched background)
